entities.name: Amazon Macie (central account)
entities.rationale: Macie icon inside the large left 'AWS Account' box (central/security account). Circled in yellow; aggregates findings and writes them to the findings S3 bucket.

entities.name: Findings S3 Bucket
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn green bucket inside the left 'AWS Account' box, between Athena and Macie. Stores Macie findings metadata (no PII).

entities.name: Amazon Athena
entities.rationale: Athena icon inside the left 'AWS Account' box, circled in yellow. Queries the findings S3 bucket with SQL.

entities.name: Amazon QuickSight
entities.rationale: QuickSight icon inside the left 'AWS Account' box, circled in yellow. Dashboards built on findings read from the S3 bucket via Athena.

entities.name: AWS Glue
entities.rationale: Glue icon inside the left 'AWS Account' box, circled in yellow. Automations that get, load and aggregate the findings data.

entities.name: MySQL Data Lake
entities.rationale: MySQL database icon inside the left 'AWS Account' box. Self-built MySQL data lake where findings data is dropped; no exact AWS service match, mapped to ThirdParty.

entities.name: Security Engineers
entities.rationale: People icon labelled 'Security Engineers' inside the left 'AWS Account' box. Actors who review dashboards and remediate with bucket owners.

entities.name: Amazon Macie (production account 1)
entities.rationale: Macie icon inside the top-right 'AWS Account' box, circled in yellow. Member production account connected to Macie.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (production account 1)
entities.rationale: S3 icon inside the top-right 'AWS Account' box next to Macie. Buckets in the production account that Macie inventories and scans.

entities.name: Amazon Macie (production account 2)
entities.rationale: Macie icon inside the bottom-right 'AWS Account' box, circled in yellow. Member production account connected to Macie.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (production account 2)
entities.rationale: S3 icon inside the bottom-right 'AWS Account' box, circled in yellow. Buckets in the production account that Macie inventories and scans.

visual_connections.description: Curved yellow arrow from the top of the central Macie icon to the hand-drawn S3 bucket: Macie findings (metadata) are written to the bucket.
Yellow arrow from Athena pointing to the S3 bucket: Athena queries the findings in the bucket.
Long yellow arrow from the QuickSight circle up to the S3 bucket: QuickSight peers into the findings in S3 (via Athena) for dashboards.
Yellow double-headed arrow between the S3 bucket and the MySQL icon: findings data is dropped into the MySQL data lake.
